answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. A lotus of per-task receipts records who did what, and the quill of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, diluted when peers disagree, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the jetty of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
